name: Milena Petrović
bio:
Milena's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly after a cybersecurity internship at a Formula 1 supplier. Intrigued by the complex data analysis and real-time communications crucial to racing, she transitioned from general IT security to specialized systems management within motorsport. Her pragmatic approach focuses on robust, reliable, and secure IT infrastructures, ensuring teams have seamless access to vital data during races and development.

Prior to joining the free agent market, Milena spent several years at a mid-tier racing team, where she spearheaded the implementation of a new data acquisition system that improved telemetry analysis by 15%. She is known for her calm demeanor under pressure and her ability to troubleshoot complex IT issues swiftly. She is ambitious and hopes to join a top-tier team where she can contribute to a championship-winning effort.

Milena is an advocate for open-source solutions when appropriate, believing that collaboration and community-driven development can lead to more secure and innovative systems within a financially responsible framework. She's also passionate about mentoring young women in STEM, hoping to increase female representation in motorsport's technical roles.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair usually tied back in a low ponytail
